name: xgb-cpu-hist-32-depth4-bounded
purpose: Bounded engineering candidate, not authorization for full-data training or promotion

training.selection: Predeclared deterministic label-independent sample; preserve selected occurrence identities and duplicate multiplicity
training.required_preflight: Reject null/nonbinary labels, nonfinite/nonpositive weights, non-784 vectors and nonfinite prepared values

missing_parameter: IEEE NaN, not zero; JSON has no standard NaN literal
evaluation_proposal: Only separately approved May-August 2024 validation scoring, with existing monthly metrics and validation-only threshold selection; no test period. A sampled-training candidate is not an apples-to-apples full-training LR challenger.
stop_conditions: Timeout, memory cap, temporal/schema failure, or preservation failure; no resource escalation or fallback to missing=0
full_data_training: BLOCKED on current two-worker resources; not proposed or executed
